tools.name: search_gondi
tools.description:
Find collections, artists, NFTs and users on GONDI by name. Call it
first whenever you have a name rather than a slug: never guess a slug,
take it from the result. Each match carries its slug or address, its
chain where it has one, and gondi_url, its GONDI page to hand the
user.

tools.name: get_collection_market
tools.description:
A collection's prices on GONDI: its floor price and its top
collection bid, each in its currency and in USD. Answers "what is the
floor of X" and "what's the top bid on X collection". It takes a slug:
when you have a name, call search_gondi first and take the slug from
its result.

tools.name: get_nft_market
tools.description:
One NFT's prices on GONDI: what it is listed for, the top bid on
it, its last sale, its estimated value and whether it is collateral in
an open loan. Answers "what's this NFT listed for" and "what's the top
bid on Y". It takes a collection slug and a token id: when you have a
name, call search_gondi

tools.name: list_cheapest_for_sale
tools.description:
The cheapest NFTs for sale on GONDI from one collection or by one
artist, cheapest first: each with its listing price in its currency
and in USD, the marketplace it is listed on and gondi_url, the page
where the user buys it. Answers "what's the cheapest NFT from this
collection" and "what's the che

tools.name: get_lending_market_overview
tools.description:
Snapshot of the whole GONDI lending market in USD: open principal,
interest paid to and accruing for lenders, and per rolling window the
principal originated and the effective APR quartiles of new loans.

tools.name: get_supported_markets
tools.description:
Where and how GONDI lends: per chain the MultiSourceLoan contract to
approve and the principal currencies with their decimals, plus the
offer durations the API accepts and the protocol fee on interest.

tools.name: get_lending_guide
tools.description:
How lending on GONDI works, step by step, with its risks and the
units these tools answer in. Read it before advising a lender.

tools.name: list_lending_opportunities
tools.description:
Collections borrowers take loans against, ranked: open loans and
principal, repayment rate, floor price and how many offers lenders
already hold. A collection and its wrappers (CryptoPunks and its wrapped
forms) are one row, under the collection they wrap. Start here to find
where to lend.

tools.name: get_collection_lending_stats
tools.description:
One collection's lending picture: floor price, open loans, repayment
rate, and the principal, APR and remaining-time ranges of its open loans
in one currency. Use it to price an offer on the collection.

tools.name: list_loan_offers
tools.description:
Active, public loan offers lenders have signed: what they lend, at
which APR and for how long, against which collection or NFT. These are
the terms a new offer competes with. For a borrower, sort_by APR_BPS
with order ASC answers the cheapest loan on a collection.

tools.name: get_top_lenders
tools.description:
The leading GONDI lenders over a rolling period, with their open
principal, earnings, net effective APR and default rate: a benchmark
for what lending here returns.

tools.name: get_lender_returns
tools.description:
One wallet's lending record, found by address, GONDI username or ENS
name: per currency the principal lent, realised net profit, weighted net
APR, the principal of its defaulted positions, and its open positions
